items.headline: Flood Warning issued May 17 at 8:12PM AKDT until May 18 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by high water and heavy ice runs continues
to be possible.

* WHERE...Galena and Koyukuk.

* WHEN...Until 1000 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...High water may result in flooding of rivers, creeks,
streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 800 PM AKDT, public reports continued minor flooding in
the region. High water and heavy ice runs along the Yukon
River and Koyukuk River will result in minor flooding impacts
in Galena and Koyuku
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,
television, or NOAA Weather Radio for further information.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services, law
enforcement, or to the National Weather Service when you can do so
safely.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 17 at 8:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Russian Mission, Marshall, Pilot Station, and St. Mary's.

The breakup front along the Yukon River has moved downstream of
Grayling. High water and heavy ice runs along the Lower Yukon River
may result in minor flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other
low-lying and flood-prone locations.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued May 17 at 12:38PM AKDT until May 18 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Mixed precipitation expected. Total snow accumulations up
to one inch and ice accumulations up to 0.01 inches.

* WHERE...Bering Strait Coast, Diomede, and St Lawrence Island.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 10 AM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Travel may be impacted.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Ice accumulations will be most likely on
elevated surfaces such as stairs. Surfaces may be slick.
items.areas: Shishmaref; Bering Strait Coast; St Lawrence Island
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Red Flag Warning issued May 17 at 11:51AM AKDT until May 17 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* AFFECTED AREA...Delta Junction.

* TIMING...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* WINDS...South 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph.

* HUMIDITY...As low as 20 percent Saturday afternoon and again
Sunday afternoon. RH values should recover into the 40 to 50 percent
range Saturday night.

* TEMPERATURES...Highs in the lower 60s.

* IMPACTS...Critical fire weather conditions are expected this
weekend due to a combination of low relative humidity, gusty
winds, and dry fuels. Any new fire starts or e
items.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that conditions are occurring or will
occur which could lead to the development of large and dangerous
fires. It is directed toward fire agencies, and through them, to
the public.

Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the
field of this Red Flag Warning.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 17 at 11:45AM AKDT until May 17 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 17 at 11:45AM AKDT until May 17 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Delta Junction.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM AKDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Low relative humidity and gusty winds
combined with dry fuels will lead to critical fire weather
conditions, particularly Sunday afternoon.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 16 at 12:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Fort Yukon, Beaver, Stevens Village, Rampart and Tanana.

High water due to snowmelt continues to make its way down the Yukon
River, which will eventually encounter the breakup front which is
approaching Grayling. High water may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
items.areas: Dalton Highway Summits; Yukon Flats; Central Interior
